channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: UCLA men coast to victory over short-handed, slumping Oregon
item.description: Tyler Bilodeau has 18 points, Eric Dailey Jr. adds a double-double and the Bruins handle a Ducks team that is missing three of its top four scorers, 73-57, for a third straight win.

item.title: Tesoro boys basketball overwhelms San Juan Hills to move closer to league title
item.description: Tesoro builds a huge lead against its shorthanded opponent, and is now within reach of clinching a share of the South Coast League title.

item.title: Hollywood Burbank Airport officials say safety is ‘our top priority’
item.description: NTSB Board Chair Jennifer Homendy said airline officials have told her "the next mid-air (collision) is going to be at Burbank"

item.title: Santa Margarita boys basketball makes history with win over Mater Dei
item.description: A stunning fourth-quarter comeback lifts Santa Margarita to a win over Mater Dei -- its first as a visiting team -- and into a tie for first place in the Trinity League.

item.title: With playoffs looming, JSerra boys basketball races to win over Servite
item.description: Ryan Doane, Godschoice Eboigbodin and Earl Bryson each contribute double-digit points and more in a lopsided win in the Trinity League.

item.title: Dense fog advisory issued for 5 Freeway through Grapevine until Thursday midday – visibility down to 1/4 mile
item.description: 5 Freeway through Grapevine is under a dense fog advisory which was issued by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 2:21 a.m. The advisory is in effect until noon.

item.title: Unmentioned but present, Trump is a common denominator in efforts to strengthen Asia-Europe ties
item.description: Trump's shaking up of the global order is worrying friends and foes and driving them closer.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.

item.title: New videos show Alex Pretti scuffle with federal officers in Minneapolis 11 days before his death
item.description: The new videos have rekindled the national debate about the death of Pretti.

item.title: Escape from Washington? Senators look to start new chapters as governors
item.description: This trend highlights a shift in political ambition away from the Senate, which has become mired in dysfunction.
